reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.aiNote: The positive / negative / neutral split is decided by AI. Star ratings are not used for it.
reviews.pendingNote: The AI has not classified these reviews yet. Once it does, they move to the positive, negative or neutral section.
reviews.loadFailed: Could not load reviews. Please try again later. (This does not mean there are no reviews.)
reviews.oldNote: {count} reviews written 5 or more years ago are hidden by default.
reviews.oldShown: Reviews older than 5 years are also shown.
reviews.linkBroken: The original could not be verified (checked {date}). The link did not open, so only the summary remains.
reviews.shareAlike: This summary is provided under the same license as the original (CC BY-SA 4.0) and is a shortened rewording of part of the original made by AI.

review.writeHint: Leave a star rating and a review. Personal information such as phone numbers and emails, and profanity, will not be posted.

review.invalidRating: Please choose a rating from 1 to 5.
review.tooLong: Reviews can be up to 1,000 characters.
review.blockedProfanity: The text contains inappropriate language. Please reword it and post again.

review.dailyLimit: You can write up to 5 reviews a day. Please try again tomorrow.

takedown.title: Request removal of an external article
takedown.intro: This app summarises articles from other sites with AI and shows them with a link to the original. If you are the author or the site owner and want a summary and its link removed, please tell us with the form below. After confirming who you are, we will remove the summary and link without delay and let you know the result by email.
takedown.url: Address of the original article to remove
takedown.urlHint: Enter the address of the original article, starting with https. (e.g. a Wikivoyage article address)
takedown.author: The author
takedown.emailHint: Used only to tell you the result, nowhere else.
takedown.success: We received your removal request. We will check it, act on it and let you know by email.
takedown.invalidUrl: Please enter a valid original address starting with https.
takedown.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
takedown.limit: You have reached today's limit for requests. Please try again tomorrow.
takedown.failed: Could not receive your request. Please try again in a moment.
takedown.footerLink: Request removal of an external article

compare.title: Compare routes
compare.note: Shows the same items of two routes side by side. It does not rate either as better, and empty cells say "No information".
compare.howTo: No routes are selected. Press "Add to compare" on two route pages, then press "Compare". Routes of different peaks can be compared too.
compare.sources: See each route page for the source and date of every item.
compare.full: You can compare up to 2 routes. Remove one first.

favorites.limit: You can save up to 100 favorites.

share.failed: Could not share. Please copy the address from the address bar.

visual.title: The route at a glance
visual.mapNote: Map colours are computed from elevation and slope; this is not a satellite image. The marker is the summit's coordinates, not the trekking path.
visual.chartNote: Only points whose elevation is given in the source are joined, in walking order. Distances between points and ups and downs are not reflected.
visual.chartNone: Fewer than 2 points with a known elevation were found for this route, so no graph is drawn.

account.title: Your account and privacy
account.collect: With email login we receive your email and nickname; with social login only the account ID, email and nickname. We do not store passwords ourselves; the login service (Supabase) handles them.
account.notCollect: We do not collect national ID numbers, phone numbers or payment details. Phone numbers and emails in reviews are filtered out before posting.
account.ai: Only the filtered review text is sent to OpenAI to classify it as positive, negative or neutral. Nickname, account, email and star rating are not sent.
account.display: Reviews show your nickname, never your real name.
account.deleteBody: Deleting your account permanently removes your profile, your reviews and your favorites. This cannot be undone.
account.failed: Could not delete the account. Please try again later.
